translation:
The Lingshu, Treatise on the Manifestations of Evil Qi in the Viscera, says: When there has been a blow or a fall, and if one, drunk, enters the bedchamber, and sweats and faces the wind, then the spleen (脾) is injured.
[Note] Having been struck or fallen is injuring the external body. If, after being drunk, one enters the bedchamber, or sweats and does not know to avoid facing the wind, then evil qi lodges in the skin and flesh, injuring the internal body. These are all causes of injuring the spleen.
